description: Unshare a website, app, agent, or skill by email: each address's link stops working at once, and revoking is permanent: sharing again with the same address mails a new link. This cannot be undone, so confirm the addresses with the user first. An address with no share is reported, not refused. Sharing does not change who else can reach it. Returns each address with its state: revoked, or no_share when it held no share. Requires connecting a Valet account.

emails.description: The email addresses whose shares to revoke. Addresses that differ only in case count once.

kind.description: Omit to act on whatever the name holds; give it to have a name holding another kind refused.

name.description: The website's, app's, agent's, or skill's name.

org_name.description: The Valet organization the website, app, agent, or skill belongs to. Omit to use the organization the account joined first.

name: unshare_service

kind.description: Kind of the thing: site, app, agent, or skill.

name.description: Name of the website, app, agent, or skill whose shares were revoked.

org.description: Name of the Valet organization the call acted in.

results.description: One entry per distinct address, in the order the call named them. Repeats that differ only in case appear once.

email.description: The email address, trimmed, as first written in the call.

state.description: revoked when the address's link was revoked, no_share when it held no live share and nothing changed.

title: Unshare a website, app, agent, or skill by email
